parameters.query: select q.review_queue_id, o.opportunity_id, o.company_name, o.title, o.canonical_url, o.country_code, o.location, o.modality, o.posted_at, o.vacancy_summary, o.requirement_evidence, o.requirements_verified_at from career.review_queue q join career.opportunities o on o.opportunity_id = q.opportunity_id where q.review_state = 'pending' order by q.priority desc, q.created_at asc limit 50;

with saved_score as (select * from career.upsert_opportunity_score($1, $2::jsonb, $3::timestamptz)), updated_queue as (update career.review_queue q set priority = $4::smallint, review_state = case when $5 = 'discard' then 'discarded' else 'in_review' end, reviewed_at = case when $5 = 'discard' then now() else null end, updated_at = now() from saved_score s where q.opportunity_id = s.opportunity_id and q.review_state = 'pending' returning q.review_queue_id, q.opportunity_id, q.review_state, q.priority) select u.review_queue_id, u.opportunity_id, u.review_state, u.priority, s.score_breakdown, s.score_updated_at, $5::text as route from saved_score s join updated_queue u on u.opportunity_id = s.opportunity_id;
